items.headline: Albemarle Has Lost 52% Since April: BMO Sees 70% Upside
items.snippet: Albemarle's Q2 was strong (net sales +31% to $1.7B, adj. EBITDA $858M), but Q3 Energy Storage sales and EBITDA are expected to decrease sequentially on lower volumes and pricing. Stock was at $105.78 on Sept. 30.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Truist and Argus highlight Albemarle cost efficiencies and capital discipline. Price targets cut across RBC, BofA, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Mizuho, UBS and Argus on softer lithium sentiment and recent spot weakness.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform, following recent lithium spot price weakness; still views the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market: demand up 45% through May on stationary storage and EVs, supply lagging. Maintained 2026 outlook at the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; the deal must be ratified by member vote.
